title: Retrospective
description: Fast-loop task retrospective produced by the Learning Evaluator, .agent/runs/<TASK-ID>/retrospective.json (spec §13.2, F.10, Appendix B, DESIGN.md §3). Proposals are candidates and are never auto-applied. Normative example: spec F.10 (ACCOUNT-12).

task.description: Task id this retrospective covers (spec F.10).

trigger.description: Trigger event, per the §13.2 trigger list (failed task / architecture rejection / human correction / high-cost run / unexpected escalation / rollback / unusually strong success worth learning from).

candidate_interventions.description: Proposed interventions, preferring 'make the mistake impossible' over prose (spec §13.2, F.10 Done means).

kind.description: Intervention category, per the §13.2 'What should change?' list.

eval_case.description: Path to a replayable eval case this failure produced, e.g. .agent/evals/architecture/ARCH-017.yaml (spec §13.5, F.10). Optional: not every retrospective yields a new eval case.

status.description: Retrospective status. F.10 always writes 'proposed' — interventions are never auto-applied (spec F.10); 'accepted'/'rejected'/'applied' are the human- or canary-driven promotion states implied by §13.6 and F.10's 'humans or canaries promote them' (inferred lifecycle, not a literal spec enum).
